फलमुख: Phalamukha — a commander of Bhaṇḍa. Br. IV. 21. 78.
फलव्रतम्: Phalavratam — the observance of the vow leads one to the world of Viṣṇu M. 101. 62.
फलसप्तमी: Phalasaptamī — in the saptamī of the Mārgaśīrṣa month in honour of the Sun God; he who does this goes to the world of Sūrya. M. 76. 1.
फल्गुतन्त्र: Phalgutantra — a king of Ayodhyā, defeated by Tāla-jangha: settled in the forest near Aurva's hermitage follow-ed by his pregnant wife. After his death was born the future Sagara in the hermitage. Br. III. 47. 76.
फल्गुतीर्थम्: Phalgutīrtham — in Gayā: Here resides Gadādhara. Vā. 105. 6, 36; 109. 16, 43; 111. 13-20.
फल्गुनि: Phalguni — the name of an asterism. Vā. 82. 6.
फालमुख: Phālamukha — a brother of Balāhaka and a commander of Bhaṇḍa. Br. IV. 24. 9 and 48.
फाल्गुण: Phālguṇa (I) — the amāvāsya in the month of, (March-April); a Manvantarādi for śrāddha. M. 17. 7.
Phālguṇa (II) — (also Phalguṇa) sacred to Hari; visited by Balarāma. Bhā. VII. 14. 31; X. 79. 18.
Phālguṇa (III) — another name of Arjuna. Vi. V. 37. 2; 38. 35.
फाल्गुनि: Phālguni (I) — sacred to the planet Guru: śrāddha per-formed that day, gives one beauty of form. Br. II. 24. 132; III. 18. 6; Vā. 23. 107; 53. 107.

Phālguni (II) — the month of, good for the gift of the Liṅga Purāṇa;1 Mahādeva to be worshipped in the month of, by the person who observes Kṛṣṇāṣṭamīvrata;2 Panca-gavya to be taken in this month while observing Saubhāgya-śayanavrata.3 1) M. 53. 38. 2) Ib. 56. 2. 3) Ib. 60. 36.
फेनप: Phenapas — a class of seers;1 Bhārgava-gotrakāras.2 1) Bhā. III. 12. 43. 2) M. 195. 21.
